facts.fact: Liberia's National Identification Registry says it cannot fully access its biometric database because Kenyan builder Techno Brain withholds access until the government pays a US$1.7 million debt, per New Narratives.

LBR.note: No public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: Liberia's national digital ID system holds biometric data (photographs and fingerprints) for 640,000 people enrolled under an earlier version, and the registry issues cards, though rollout was halted in 2025, per New Narratives.
